content.text: A bright orange foam dart flies in slow motion across a plain white room toward a glowing hexagonal wall lamp made of white triangular panels. Macro tracking shot following the dart from behind, shallow depth of field, soft daylight from a window on the left, clean minimal palette of white, orange and warm grey. The dart tips the lamp and the panels ripple with a soft pulse of light. Ambient room tone only, a faint whoosh as the dart passes and a soft thud on impact. No music.
